svg.title: Strobe Assistant ACP + MCP path
svg.text: Strobe Assistant — the ACP + MCP path
How one chat message reaches the agent, the model and the tools. Highlighted: the conversational path. Grey: supporting services.
serves the static client bundle only;
it does not proxy the agent
ACP server towards the UI · MCP client towards the tools
stateless · the only component with data access
(the last two are hidden from the model)
injected from the verified token, never a tool argument
config read once at start-up (agent + MCP)
public keys for the JWT checks
Vectors and classifications are written earlier by the
async ingest pipeline (S3 → SQS → worker Lambda), not shown.
Browser signs in through the A1 API and receives a Cognito ID token.
Browser opens wss://…/acp. Route 53 resolves to the ALB; the ACM cert makes it wss.
Rule /acp* forwards the WebSocket upgrade to the agent; one agent per connection.
Agent streams each model step from Bedrock (Gemma 3) under the task's IAM role.
Agent's MCP client calls https://…/mcp with the user's token — back through the ALB.
Rule /mcp* forwards to the MCP server, which verifies the token a second time.
Tools embed with Titan and read S3 Vectors, DynamoDB, S3 and the A1 API, scoped to sub.
